hero.lead: Casablanca → Rabat → Fes → Chefchaouen → Sahara Desert → Marrakech

paras: Our longest and most complete route — imperial cities, mountain passes, the blue lanes of Chefchaouen, a night in the Sahara, and Marrakech's medina, all in one shared circuit with enough days built in that no leg feels like a race against the clock.
Total driving distance is around 1,530 km over ten days, the most ground we cover on any single itinerary.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Casablanca arrival
paras: Group welcome in Casablanca with a stop at the Hassan II Mosque. Evening free on the seafront corniche. Overnight in Casablanca.

days.label: Rabat
days.title: Casablanca to Meknes via Rabat
paras: Morning stop in Rabat (≈90 km/1 hr) for the Kasbah of the Udayas and Hassan Tower, then on to Meknes (≈140 km/2 hrs) for the night.

days.label: Volubilis
days.title: Meknes to Fes via Volubilis
paras: Morning tour of Meknes' royal stables, a stop at the Roman ruins of Volubilis (≈30 km/30 min), then on to Fes (≈60 km/1 hr) for the night.

days.label: Fes
days.title: Fes medina exploration
paras: Full guided day through the Fes el-Bali medina — tanneries, souks, and the Bou Inania Madrasa. Overnight in Fes.

days.label: Chefchaouen
days.title: Fes to Chefchaouen
paras: Scenic drive north through the Rif Mountains. Afternoon free to wander the blue medina, with an optional sunset hike to the Spanish Mosque viewpoint. Overnight in Chefchaouen.

days.label: Transfer
days.title: Chefchaouen to Midelt
paras: Long but scenic drive south through the Middle Atlas cedar forests near Ifrane (look out for Barbary macaques) to the mountain gateway town of Midelt. Overnight in Midelt.

days.label: Desert
days.title: Midelt to Merzouga Sahara camp
paras: Short, dramatic drive down through the Ziz Valley gorge to Merzouga. Camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes for a night at the shared desert camp.

days.label: Return
days.title: Sahara camp to Ouarzazate
paras: Optional sunrise over the dunes, then a scenic drive back across the Atlas via Tinghir and the Todra and Dades Gorges, arriving in Ouarzazate for the night.

days.label: Marrakech
days.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech via Ait Benhaddou
paras: Stop at the UNESCO-listed Ait Benhaddou kasbah before crossing the High Atlas to Marrakech, arriving with the evening free in the medina. Overnight in Marrakech.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Departure from Marrakech
paras: Free morning before your group transfer to Marrakech airport or onward accommodation. Trip ends.

intro: Nine nights, shared throughout. Expect the same style and price bracket as these real budget properties in each city.

cards.title: Night 1 · Casablanca
html: A simple city hostel comparable to Aya House or Medina Guesthouse - Hostel — shared or twin rooms, from roughly €15–25/night.

cards.title: Night 2 · Meknes
html: A small, no-frills hotel near the medina, in the same bracket as Meknes' budget listings from around €14–20/night.

cards.title: Nights 3–4 · Fes
html: A budget medina hostel comparable to Moroccan Dream Hostel or Riad Verus — traditional courtyard house, shared or twin rooms.

cards.title: Night 5 · Chefchaouen
html: A small blue-medina guesthouse similar to Bleu Home or Pension Soukia.

cards.title: Night 6 · Midelt
html: A simple mountain-gateway guesthouse — basic twin rooms, used as an overnight stop before the Ziz Valley descent.

cards.title: Night 7 · Merzouga desert camp
html: Ideal Desert Camp, half board (HB) — dorm tents, shared bathrooms, dinner and breakfast included.

cards.title: Night 8 · Ouarzazate
html: A budget guesthouse near the medina, similar to Le Petit Riad.

cards.title: Night 9 · Marrakech
html: A medina riad comparable to Riad Jennah Rouge or Riad les Oliviers — dorm beds from around €15, near Jemaa el-Fnaa.

cards.title: Private upgrade
html: Private rooms are available on every night as a paid upgrade — let us know at booking, subject to availability.

includes: Shared transport in an air-conditioned minivan
Camel trek and 1 night at the desert camp
Guided walking tours in Rabat, Meknes, Fes and Marrakech
excludes: Hassan II Mosque interior tour ticket (optional add-on)
Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

paras: Groups are capped at 16 travelers. Departures run every other Sunday year-round — this route sells out fastest in October–April, so book a few weeks ahead in peak season.
Prefer a shorter version focused on either the Sahara and Fes or the desert and coast? See our 8-Day Marrakech, Sahara, Fes & Chefchaouen Tour or 8-Day Desert & Coast Tour.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: Is this trip too much driving?
items.a: It's our longest route in total distance, but it's spread over ten days with full free days in Fes and rest built into the schedule — no day exceeds about 5.5 hours of driving.

items.q: Can I join partway through, e.g. skip the imperial cities?
items.a: Yes — let us know at booking if you'd like to join in Fes or Marrakech instead of Casablanca. Pricing is adjusted accordingly.

items.q: Is accommodation shared for all 9 nights?
items.a: Yes, the €749 price is based on shared twin/dorm rooms throughout. A private room upgrade is available on request, subject to availability.

items.q: What should I pack for the desert night?
items.a: Desert nights get cold even in summer — bring a warm layer, plus sunscreen, a scarf or hat for wind and sun, and comfortable walking shoes.

items.q: What if the group doesn't fill up?
items.a: Departures run on fixed dates regardless of group size — your trip runs even if only a few seats are booked.
